description: This file defines a specialized Vectorized class for quantized 8-bit integer types (c10::qint8), including methods for loading, storing, dequantizing, quantizing, and various vector operations, optimized for VSX instructions on CPU.

classes.name: Vectorized<c10::qint8>
classes.description: A specialized vector class for quantized 8-bit integers with methods for dequantization, quantization, and vector operations.

methods.name: loadu
methods.description: Loads unaligned vector data from memory into a Vectorized<c10::qint8> object.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores the vector data into memory.

methods.name: dequantize
methods.description: Converts quantized integers to floating point vectors using scale and zero point.

methods.name: quantize
methods.description: Converts floating point vectors to quantized integers given scale, zero point, and inverse scale.

methods.name: relu
methods.description: Applies ReLU activation by max with zero point.

methods.name: relu6
methods.description: Applies ReLU6 activation with upper bound.

methods.name: widening_subtract
methods.description: Performs widening subtraction between two quantized vectors.

methods.name: requantize_from_int
methods.description: Requantizes integer vectors to quantized 8-bit vectors with a multiplier and zero point.
